toefl:se:177.japanese: カスタマーサポート様、
toefl:se:177.explanation: Dear 〜,はビジネスメールの定型の書き出し。
toefl:se:177.relatedInfo: Dear Sir or Madam, / To whom it may concern,

toefl:se:178.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:178.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this email finds you well
toefl:se:178.japanese: このメールが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:178.explanation: ビジネスメール冒頭の定型挨拶表現。
toefl:se:178.relatedInfo: I hope you are doing well. / I hope this message finds you well.

toefl:se:179.answer: I am writing about an issue with the wireless mouse I recently purchased from your company.
toefl:se:179.fullSentence: I am writing about an issue with the wireless mouse I recently purchased from your company.
toefl:se:179.japanese: 御社から最近購入したワイヤレスマウスの不具合について書いています。
toefl:se:179.explanation: I am writing about〜はメールの用件を伝える定型表現。
toefl:se:179.relatedInfo: I am contacting you regarding / I am reaching out about

toefl:se:180.answer: After only a few days of use, the mouse suddenly stopped working.
toefl:se:180.fullSentence: After only a few days of use, the mouse suddenly stopped working.
keyPhrases: after only a few days of use
toefl:se:180.japanese: 使い始めてわずか数日で、マウスが突然動かなくなりました。
toefl:se:180.explanation: After only〜で「わずか〜の後」と短さを強調する。

toefl:se:181.answer: I have already tried replacing the batteries and troubleshooting by restarting my computer and reconnecting the receiver, but the problem continues.
toefl:se:181.fullSentence: I have already tried replacing the batteries and troubleshooting by restarting my computer and reconnecting the receiver, but the problem continues.
keyPhrases: restarting my computer and reconnecting the receiver
toefl:se:181.japanese: 電池の交換や、コンピューターの再起動、受信機の再接続によるトラブルシューティングは既に試しましたが、問題は解決しません。
toefl:se:181.explanation: have already triedで既に試した対応策を示す現在完了。
toefl:se:181.relatedInfo: the issue persists / the problem remains unresolved

toefl:se:182.answer: Could you please provide instructions on how to repair the mouse, or let me know if a replacement is possible?
toefl:se:182.fullSentence: Could you please provide instructions on how to repair the mouse, or let me know if a replacement is possible?
keyPhrases: provide instructions on how to repair
let me know if a replacement is possible
toefl:se:182.japanese: マウスの修理方法をご案内いただくか、交換が可能かどうかお知らせいただけますでしょうか。
toefl:se:182.explanation: Could you please〜?は丁寧な依頼を表す定型表現。
toefl:se:182.relatedInfo: Would you be able to advise on / Could you tell me whether

toefl:se:183.answer: Your assistance would be greatly appreciated.
toefl:se:183.fullSentence: Your assistance would be greatly appreciated.
keyPhrases: your assistance would be greatly appreciated
toefl:se:183.japanese: ご協力いただけますと大変ありがたく存じます。
toefl:se:183.explanation: would be greatly appreciatedはビジネスメールで感謝を丁寧に伝える定型表現。
toefl:se:183.relatedInfo: I would greatly appreciate your help / Your help would mean a lot

toefl:se:184.answer: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:184.fullSentence: I look forward to your response.
keyPhrases: i look forward to your response
toefl:se:184.japanese: お返事をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:184.explanation: look forward to〜はメールの結びの定型表現。
toefl:se:184.relatedInfo: I look forward to hearing from you / Awaiting your reply

toefl:se:185.japanese: カスタマーサポート様、
toefl:se:185.explanation: フォーマルなビジネスメールの書き出し。
toefl:se:185.relatedInfo: Dear Sir or Madam, / To the Customer Support Team,

toefl:se:186.answer: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:186.fullSentence: I hope this message finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this message finds you well
toefl:se:186.japanese: このメッセージが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:186.explanation: 定型の挨拶表現。messageはemailの言い換え。
toefl:se:186.relatedInfo: I hope this email finds you well. / I trust this message finds you well.

toefl:se:187.answer: I am writing to address an issue with the recent order I placed with your store.
toefl:se:187.fullSentence: I am writing to address an issue with the recent order I placed with your store.
toefl:se:187.japanese: 御社に注文した最近の注文について、問題をお伝えするために書いています。
toefl:se:187.explanation: writing to addressで「〜に対処するために書く」を表す。
toefl:se:187.relatedInfo: writing to report a problem with / contacting you about an issue with

toefl:se:188.answer: I ordered a blue jacket in size Medium, but upon receiving the package yesterday, I discovered that the jacket sent to me is a red one in size Large.
toefl:se:188.fullSentence: I ordered a blue jacket in size Medium, but upon receiving the package yesterday, I discovered that the jacket sent to me is a red one in size Large.
keyPhrases: ordered a blue jacket in size medium
toefl:se:188.japanese: 私はMサイズの青いジャケットを注文しましたが、昨日荷物を受け取った際、届いたのはLサイズの赤いジャケットであることに気づきました。
toefl:se:188.explanation: upon -ingで「〜するとすぐに」というフォーマルな表現。
toefl:se:188.relatedInfo: upon opening the package / discovered upon delivery

toefl:se:189.answer: This mistake has caused me quite a bit of inconvenience as I planned to wear the jacket for a special event this weekend and now do not have the appropriate attire.
toefl:se:189.fullSentence: This mistake has caused me quite a bit of inconvenience as I planned to wear the jacket for a special event this weekend and now do not have the appropriate attire.
keyPhrases: caused me quite a bit of inconvenience
toefl:se:189.japanese: 今週末の特別なイベントでこのジャケットを着る予定だったため、この間違いは私にかなりの不便をもたらしており、今は適切な服装がありません。
toefl:se:189.explanation: as以下は理由を表す接続詞節。
toefl:se:189.relatedInfo: caused a great deal of trouble / left me without proper attire

toefl:se:190.answer: Moreover, the incorrect size makes it impractical for daily use, and the color is different from what I selected.
toefl:se:190.fullSentence: Moreover, the incorrect size makes it impractical for daily use, and the color is different from what I selected.
keyPhrases: makes it impractical for daily use
color is different from what i selected
toefl:se:190.japanese: さらに、サイズが間違っているため日常使いには実用的でなく、色も私が選んだものと異なります。
toefl:se:190.explanation: make it impractical for〜で「〜に不向きにする」を表す。
toefl:se:190.relatedInfo: unsuitable for everyday wear / does not match what I chose

toefl:se:191.answer: I kindly request that you send me the correct item as soon as possible.
toefl:se:191.fullSentence: I kindly request that you send me the correct item as soon as possible.
toefl:se:191.japanese: 正しい商品をできるだけ早く送っていただきますようお願い申し上げます。
toefl:se:191.explanation: kindly requestはビジネスメールで丁寧に依頼する定型表現。
toefl:se:191.relatedInfo: I would kindly ask that you / please arrange for the correct item

toefl:se:192.answer: If this is not feasible, I would appreciate a full refund of my purchase.
toefl:se:192.fullSentence: If this is not feasible, I would appreciate a full refund of my purchase.
toefl:se:192.japanese: もしそれが難しい場合は、購入代金の全額返金をいただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:192.explanation: feasibleは「実行可能な」という意味のフォーマルな語。
toefl:se:192.relatedInfo: if that is not possible / if that cannot be arranged

toefl:se:193.answer: Please let me know how to proceed with returning the incorrect jacket, and thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
toefl:se:193.fullSentence: Please let me know how to proceed with returning the incorrect jacket, and thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
toefl:se:193.japanese: 間違ったジャケットの返品方法をお知らせください。また、本件への迅速なご対応に感謝申し上げます。
toefl:se:193.explanation: prompt attention to this matterはビジネスメールでよく使う定型結び。
toefl:se:193.relatedInfo: advise on the return process / your quick response to this issue

toefl:se:194.answer: I'm looking forward to your swift resolution.
toefl:se:194.fullSentence: I'm looking forward to your swift resolution.
keyPhrases: looking forward to your swift resolution
toefl:se:194.japanese: 迅速な解決を楽しみにお待ちしております。
toefl:se:194.explanation: swift resolutionで「迅速な解決」という表現。
toefl:se:194.relatedInfo: a quick resolution / a speedy solution

toefl:se:195.explanation: ビジネスメールの結びの定型表現。

toefl:se:196.explanation: カジュアルなメールの書き出し。

toefl:se:197.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:197.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this email finds you well
toefl:se:197.japanese: このメールが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:197.relatedInfo: I hope you're doing well. / I hope all is well.

toefl:se:198.answer: I am writing because I received the wrong jacket from my order.
toefl:se:198.fullSentence: I am writing because I received the wrong jacket from my order.
keyPhrases: writing because i received the wrong jacket
toefl:se:198.japanese: 注文した商品と違うジャケットが届いたため、ご連絡しています。
toefl:se:198.explanation: I am writing becauseで理由を簡潔に伝える表現。
toefl:se:198.relatedInfo: got the wrong item / received an incorrect item

toefl:se:199.answer: I ordered a jacket in a different size and color than what I received.
toefl:se:199.fullSentence: I ordered a jacket in a different size and color than what I received.
keyPhrases: ordered a jacket in a different size and color
toefl:se:199.japanese: 私は届いたものとは異なるサイズと色のジャケットを注文しました。
toefl:se:199.explanation: than what I receivedはthe jacketとの比較を示す。
toefl:se:199.relatedInfo: different from what arrived / not what I received

toefl:se:200.answer: This mistake has inconvenienced me because I cannot use the jacket I wanted for the event I planned.
toefl:se:200.fullSentence: This mistake has inconvenienced me because I cannot use the jacket I wanted for the event I planned.
keyPhrases: cannot use the jacket i wanted
toefl:se:200.japanese: この間違いは、計画していたイベントで着たかったジャケットが使えないため、私に不便をもたらしています。
toefl:se:200.explanation: inconvenience 人は「人に不便をかける」という動詞用法。
toefl:se:200.relatedInfo: caused me trouble / created difficulty for me

toefl:se:201.answer: I would like to return the jacket and receive a refund or the correct item.
toefl:se:201.fullSentence: I would like to return the jacket and receive a refund or the correct item.
keyPhrases: would like to return the jacket
toefl:se:201.japanese: ジャケットを返品し、返金または正しい商品を受け取りたいと思います。
toefl:se:201.explanation: would like to doは丁寧な希望を表す表現。
toefl:se:201.relatedInfo: wish to return the item / hope to get a refund or replacement
